question: on the frozen protocol (5 folds x 10 repeats, GroupKFold by InChIKey, Physical(lever4), frozen pool/mask/splitter/scorer), does swapping the model head clear 0.70?

frozen_protocol.head_process: ProcessPoolExecutor over (repeat, fold) tasks, one fold per task

arm_definitions.xgb_reference: frozen head: XGBRegressor(**XGB_PARAMS) = 200 trees, max_depth 2, lr 0.05, random_state 42 (anchor, must reproduce bit for bit)
arm_definitions.xgb_deep: depth 8, 1200 trees, lr 0.03, rest of XGB_PARAMS inherited
arm_definitions.kernel_ridge: RBF KernelRidge(alpha=1.0, gamma=1/13) on training-fold-standardised features and z-scored target
arm_definitions.mlp: MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,32), max_iter=1500, random_state=42) on the same standardised pair
arm_definitions.blend_uniform: arithmetic mean of the five single families, weights pinned in advance at 1/5 each
arm_definitions.selected_inner_cv: best single family by a 3-fold GroupKFold inside the training fold only (ties break on arm name), then refit on the whole training fold; the held-out fold is never seen by the choice

decision_rule.confirmed: best head (at the anchor seed) R2 >= 0.70 AND its improvement over xgb_reference >= 0.02 AND the cross-seed mean of that head >= 0.70 AND at least 3 seeds were run
decision_rule.partial: best-head improvement over xgb_reference >= 0.005 but the 0.70 gate is not met
decision_rule.placebo: verdict is placebo when --placebo is used; the target is permuted on the scored compounds only

anchors.fold_signature: must equal dielectric_pool_expansion_benchmark.fold_signature of the frozen scoreboard splits
anchors.on_mismatch: refuse to report anything else and exit non-zero
